answer: Random peer audit protects a meadow network from bulk fake identities. Each applicant posts a 30-token bond and one checkable reading. Auditors drawn at random must reproduce it; a sable flag marks any mismatch publicly and the bond is slashed. An echo must pass every listener, not one gate. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 tokens, with no extra reward, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its bond and earns undiluted rewards.
